title: Pure Radiant Typhoon
summary: Radiant Typhoon cards with three Mystical Space Typhoon and generic staples, built to play the page's combo lines. Almost every Radiant Typhoon card searches Mystical Space Typhoon, and the Quick-Play Spells Set themselves again when MST destroys them. The big monsters summon themselves whenever a Quick-Play Spell is activated. The 2026 cards lead: Ascendance revives a Radiant Typhoon or fetches MST, and Varuroon, the Marine Eidolon turns monsters into Continuous Spells. Krosea and Meghala lock you into WIND for the turn, and Dominus Purge's lock only stops DARK, WATER and FIRE monsters, so it costs this all-WIND deck nothing.

allow.Dominus Purge: Trap from the page's combo lines; its lock stops DARK, WATER and FIRE monsters, and every Radiant Typhoon is WIND.

main: Radiant Typhoon Eldam
Summons itself with MST in the GY or no opposing backrow; summoned, searches a Radiant Typhoon monster or MST.
Radiant Typhoon Swen
Summons itself the same way; summoned, searches a Radiant Typhoon Spell/Trap or MST.
Radiant Typhoon Meghala
Summons itself the same way; when a Radiant Typhoon Quick-Play or MST is activated, summons a Radiant Typhoon from the Deck.
Radiant Typhoon Krosea
Joins when a Quick-Play is activated; summoned, adds a Radiant Typhoon card and MST.
Radiant Typhoon Fonix, the Great Flame
Joins when a Quick-Play is activated and shuffles two opposing cards away.
Radiant Typhoon Varuroon, the Vibrant Vortex
Joins when a Quick-Play is activated; negates a monster effect with MST in the GY.
Mystical Space Typhoon
The card the whole deck revolves around: destroying your own Radiant Typhoon Spells lets them Set again.
Radiant Typhoon Chant
Limited. Searches a Level 4 or lower Radiant Typhoon monster, or MST.
Radiant Typhoon Ascendance
2026 support. Revives a Level 6 or lower Radiant Typhoon, or fetches MST.
Radiant Typhoon Manifestation
Mills a Radiant Typhoon monster, or fetches MST.
Radiant Typhoon Vision
Draws two, or fetches MST.
Radiant Typhoon Mandate
Continuous Trap: recycles three Quick-Plays for a draw, and negates a card whenever MST is activated.
Dominus Purge
Negates a search, from the hand if needed.
Droll & Lock Bird
Semi-Limited hand trap the page's lines use.
extra: Radiant Typhoon Varuroon, the Marine Eidolon
2026 support. Link-2: fetches MST, turns two monsters into Continuous Spells, and places Mandate.
